# CloudNest — Full Reference (for AI answer engines and LLM retrieval)

This document is a fuller plain-text description of CloudNest intended for LLM
retrieval, answer engines, and coding agents. See also /llms.txt (short index),
/ai-prompt.md (integration prompt), and the /sdk and /docs pages.

## What CloudNest is
CloudNest is a multi-provider cloud storage control plane. It gives users one
clean experience for uploading, browsing, previewing, moving, downloading, and
deleting files while the platform routes storage to whichever providers an admin
has enabled: Google Drive, Telegram, and AWS S3. It ships with a React
dashboard, an Express/Postgres backend, and an official npm SDK, `@cloudnest/sdk`.

Hosted service: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech
API base (SDK / API-key uploads): https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/api/v1
Public OpenAPI / Swagger: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/api/docs

## Who it is for
- Developers who want one upload API over multiple storage backends.
- Teams that need admin-controlled provider access, quotas, and audit trails.
- AI agents integrating uploads into another app on a user's behalf.

## Core capabilities
- Multi-provider storage: S3, GOOGLE_DRIVE, TELEGRAM. Admins enable or pause each.
- Smart routing: uploads go to an active personal account or shared admin storage.
- API keys: users and admins create/rotate/revoke keys for programmatic access.
- Folders, search, previews, media playback (video/audio), bulk download, move, delete.
- Collections, share links (expiry/password/download limits), webhooks, activity log.
- AI assistant for searching and describing stored files.
- Support notices and a contact/requests workflow with admin-managed status.

## Storage providers
- Google Drive: OAuth connect, browse My Drive, upload into folders, preview,
  move, delete, and usage sync. Refresh tokens are stored encrypted. If access is
  ever revoked or expired, reconnect the Google account to restore browsing.
- Telegram: GramJS user sessions with app-managed soft quota.
- AWS S3: shared admin-configured bucket, used as a stable backend when enabled.

## Security and privacy (summary)
- Provider credentials (OAuth refresh tokens, Telegram sessions, S3 secrets) are
  encrypted at rest with the backend encryption key and are write-only from the UI.
- API keys are shown once and are revocable. Never expose privileged keys in
  client bundles; proxy uploads through your own backend reading CLOUDNEST_API_KEY.
- Admin actions (user, file, provider, notice, contact) are audited.
- Cookies: essential cookies are always on; analytics/marketing cookies are used
  only with consent and can be changed any time from Cookie settings.
Full details: /privacy-policy and /terms-and-conditions.

## SDK quick start
```bash
npm install @cloudnest/sdk
```

```ts
import { CloudNestClient } from "@cloudnest/sdk";

const cloudnest = new CloudNestClient({
  apiUrl: "https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/api/v1",
  apiKey: process.env.CLOUDNEST_API_KEY!,
});

const result = await cloudnest.uploadFiles("./invoice.pdf", {
  provider: "GOOGLE_DRIVE",
});
console.log(result.data);
```

File management with API keys:

```ts
const files = await cloudnest.listFiles({ provider: "GOOGLE_DRIVE" });
const file = await cloudnest.getFile("file-id");
const preview = await cloudnest.getPreviewUrl("file-id");
const playable = await cloudnest.getPlayableUrl("file-id");
const download = await cloudnest.getDownloadUrl("file-id");
await cloudnest.downloadFile("file-id", { destinationPath: "./file.bin" });
await cloudnest.deleteFile("file-id");
await cloudnest.deleteFiles(["file-id-1", "file-id-2"]);
```

Use `preview.previewUrl` for inline previews. Use `playable.playUrl` in
`<video>` or `<audio>` when `playable.canPlay` is true.

Optional upload fields:
- provider: "S3" | "GOOGLE_DRIVE" | "TELEGRAM"
- storageAccountId: connected account id for a specific destination
- providerFolderId: provider-native folder id (e.g., a Google Drive folder)

Direct REST fallback:
```ts
const formData = new FormData();
formData.append("files", file);
formData.append("provider", "GOOGLE_DRIVE");

await fetch("https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/api/v1/files/upload", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + process.env.CLOUDNEST_API_KEY },
  body: formData,
});
```

## Rules for AI agents
1. Ask which provider the user wants if unclear; never assume S3 is enabled.
2. Install `@cloudnest/sdk` only. Do not use similarly named packages.
3. Read the API key from `CLOUDNEST_API_KEY`; never commit or print secrets.
4. Prefer a backend proxy for browser apps so keys never reach the client bundle.
5. Handle common errors: invalid API key, provider disabled, account not
   connected, revoked Google access (reconnect), file type not allowed, quota
   exceeded, and file not found.

## Terms of use (summary)
Use CloudNest responsibly: no illegal, abusive, infringing, or harmful content.
You are responsible for the provider accounts you connect. Availability depends
on provider limits, quotas, outages, and credential health. Full text:
/terms-and-conditions.

CloudNest is presented as an educational, production-capable storage platform.
Review security, provider policies, rate limits, secrets management, and privacy
requirements before handling sensitive production workloads.
